name: OnlyFlix Local
description: Independent OnlyFlix provider for Nuvio. Server 1 and Server 3 use the current direct VAPlayer backend; Server 2 keeps the NontonGo direct extractor with bounded timeout because the current upstream is intermittently Cloudflare-blocked.

scrapers.name: OnlyFlix · Server 1 · VidAPI
scrapers.description: Current direct VAPlayer backend used by the OnlyFlix/VidAPI family; returns HLS immediately without browser/embed preflight.
scrapers.author: OnlyFlix Local

scrapers.name: OnlyFlix · Server 2 · NontonGo
scrapers.description: Direct NontonGo sources-array resolver with bounded timeout; current upstream may return Cloudflare 403/502.
scrapers.author: OnlyFlix Local

scrapers.name: OnlyFlix · Server 3 · VidFast
scrapers.description: Current VidFast path using the shared VAPlayer backend with source=vidfast; returns HLS immediately.
scrapers.author: OnlyFlix Local
